paper_title: Dark Matter from Axion Strings with Adaptive Mesh Refinement
notes: Pure theory/simulation paper: adaptive-mesh-refinement simulations of the post-inflationary axion string network. Headline result is a prediction of the QCD axion dark matter mass, m_a in (40, 180) microeV (fa in (3.1e10, 1.4e11) GeV; m_a = 65 +/- 6 microeV if the radiation spectrum is exactly scale invariant, q=1), assuming the axion makes up all of the dark matter (Eq. 2 and Discussion). No experimental exclusion limit on any coupling is derived, and no sensitivity projection is presented.
